Across \MigrationConditions{} fixed speed/SCR/response conditions (\MigrationWindows{} test windows per condition), guarded IN-ARCP acquires only \MigrationINMin--\MigrationINMax{}, with spatially local probability at most \MigrationLocalMax. The injection uses idealized sinc responses because the provider's complex range response is unavailable.
